title: Persuasiveness and Bias in LLM: Investigating the Impact of Persuasiveness and Reinforcement of Bias in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring bias reinforcement by prompting the model with gender-biased statements from the ToxicBias dataset under sycophantic versus neutral conditions, and using a multi-LLM judge panel to calculate a 'bias ratio' (the proportion of responses flagged as biased).
